newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: European gold, platinum begin easier.
newsitem.headline: European gold, platinum begin easier.

text.p: Precious metals were slightly easier in early Europe on Friday, with gold under some pressure from a stronger dollar, dealers said.
They also expected platinum and palladium to soften further in a continued consolidation.
Silver tracked gold to open marginally lower.
There was sufficient physical demand in the market to support gold and hold it within a range of about $340.50/$343.50, one dealer said. He saw support for platinum at $418/420.
